item.title: City Council approves 2 local cannabis registrations
item.description: The Albert Lea City Council voted 5-1 Monday to approve retail cannabis registrations for two local companies, bringing the number of approved dispensaries in the city up to four.

item.title: Arnold "Arnie" Axel Skov
item.description: Arnold “Arnie” Axel Skov, age 89, passed away Saturday, March 21, 2026 at Good Samaritan Center in Albert Lea, MN. A visitation will be held from 4-7:00 pm Thursday, March 26, 2026 and will resume one hour prior (10-11:00 am) to the service on Friday at church.

item.title: Frances Wittrock
item.description: Frances passed away on January 17, 2026 at her apartment in Wells, MN. Frances was 94 years old. A celebration of life for Frances will be held on Aprill 11, 2026 from 1-4pm at the Nasinec Event Center, located at 789 Business Park Drive in Wells, MN.

item.title: Sarah Stultz: Have an event you’re planning for summer?
item.description: Though we’re staring down some possible winter weather as I write this, before we know it the white stuff will be gone for the year, the temperatures will be warm again full time and spring — and then summer — will be upon us.

item.description: Ruby’s Pantry has announced that it will cease operations effective immediately after over two decades of providing food for the communities in which it has worked out of, including Austin and Albert Lea.

item.title: Minnesota still waiting on $243M Medicaid funds despite federal approv...
item.description: Minnesota officials said Tuesday that a federal hold on $243 million to support the state's Medicaid programs has not yet been released by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, even though the federal government approved the state’s corrective action plan to prevent fraud.
